stories.headline: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks escalate
stories.summary: Egypt has approved military support for Saudi Arabia in response to escalating Houthi attacks in the region. This move signals deeper regional involvement in Middle Eastern tensions.
stories.why_matters: Middle East geopolitical escalation directly threatens energy supply chains and US strategic interests, potentially impacting crude prices and risk appetite.

stories.headline: Galp, Moeve scrap downstream merger as Iran war boosts refinery valuations
stories.summary: Galp and Moeve have cancelled their planned downstream merger due to rising refinery valuations caused by Iran-related conflict risks. The deal termination reflects changed market conditions favoring standalone refinery assets.
stories.why_matters: Energy sector restructuring tied to geopolitical risk repricing affects upstream capex, inflation expectations, and commodity-linked equity valuations.

stories.headline: Mortgage rates above 7% are the 'new normal'—here's why
stories.summary: Mortgage rates have settled above 7% and are being characterized as the 'new normal' for the housing market. This reflects broader trends in interest rate expectations.
stories.why_matters: Sustained 7%+ mortgage rates signal persistent real yields and potential consumer credit stress, impacting housing demand, equities, and Fed policy interpretation.

calendar.note: FOMC communications on Friday will set Fed expectations and may drive Treasury curve repricing amid geopolitical risk and mortgage rate dynamics.
ECI data Friday is critical for assessing wage inflation persistence in context of sustained 7%+ mortgage rates and labor market tightness.

concept.title: Geopolitical Risk Premium on Hold
concept.one_liner: Middle East escalation and Iran tensions are reshaping energy sector valuations and keeping rates higher longer despite marginal Treasury yield declines.
concept.explanation: Headlines spanning Egypt-Saudi military coordination, Hezbollah mobilization, and refinery merger cancellations reflect a live geopolitical risk repricing affecting commodities and inflation expectations. The 10Y/2Y both fell ~16-17 bps yet VIX rose 0.42, suggesting equity sellers are pricing tail risks while bond buyers flee duration. Mortgage rates anchored above 7% indicate the real yield floor remains sticky despite tactical bond strength.
concept.market_link: Energy-driven inflation fears and Middle East supply-chain uncertainty are sustaining term premium even as near-term rate cuts are delayed by fiscal and geopolitical headwinds.

narrative: S&P 500 gained 0.75% in a quiet session as Treasuries rallied 16–17 bps on mixed signals: bond buying amid geopolitical risk, but VIX ticked up and mortgage rates remain stuck above 7%, signaling the Fed's real-yield floor is holding firm despite Middle East tensions now reshaping energy valuations and regional defense spending.
